company_line: BMD, with CPB Contractors and Arup in the Tram to Springvale Alliance, is delivering the Eastern Freeway Upgrades between Tram and Springvale roads as part of the North East Link Program.
subject: Civil Site Engineer, Tram to Springvale Alliance (SEEK 95835638)
paragraphs: Please accept my application for the Civil Site Engineer role with the Tram to Springvale Alliance on the Eastern Freeway Upgrades. Earthworks, drainage and pavements on a major Melbourne road project are exactly the scopes I trained in and want to build my site career on.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, reviewed structural and architectural drawings and carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials, prepared site reports and progress reports, and worked with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers to keep work moving.

I live in Melton, hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. My site experience is about ten months and overseas, under the one to five years in the advert, so I would be learning ITPs, NCRs and permits on an Australian alliance project from your supervisors and project engineers.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
